Austria: Austria (Grundverkehr): land purchase by non-residents/foreigners is RESTRICTED and needs approval from the state land-transfer authority; Tirol, Salzburg & Vorarlberg heavily limit vacation/secondary homes (Freizeitwohnsitz).
